checks.name: live-network-and-models
command:
import httpx,math,tempfile,json
from pathlib import Path
from assistant.infra.config import Settings,make_llm
from dataclasses import replace
s=Settings.from_env()
print('ERP',httpx.get(s.erp_url+'/health').json())
print('MODEL_SERVER',httpx.get(s.llm_base_url.removesuffix('/v1')+'/api/version').json())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    llm=make_llm(replace(s,artifacts_dir=Path(directory)))
    response=llm.chat([{'role':'user','content':'Docker connectivity check. Reply only OK.'}],max_tokens=8)
    assert response.content.strip()
    vectors=llm.embed(['Docker network connectivity check.'])
    assert len(vectors)==1 and len(vectors[0])==1024 and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in vectors[0])
    print(json.dumps({'fresh_reply':response.content,'embedding_dimensions':len(vectors[0]),'llm_stats':llm.stats.as_dict()}))

scope: Full tests/lint and cached index/evaluation reproduction; separate uncached chat and embedding smoke. Not a fresh full benchmark.
